method: Analytical waste-truck route proxy: DSNY collection-frequency-zone centroid to nearest in-city DSNY waste facility, routed on the official NYC DOT Truck Route network. This is not vehicle GPS or an observed DSNY itinerary.

interpretation.routeExposure: Counts indicate reported outdoor rat sightings within 150 m of each modeled corridor. Overlapping corridors can count the same complaint more than once.
interpretation.concentrationLift: The concentration lift compares the share of rat complaints in the route corridors with a deterministic 30,000-point Monte Carlo estimate of the corridors' share of DSNY-served land.
interpretation.correlation: The Pearson correlation compares storage-time proxy days with rat sightings per modeled route-kilometre. It is descriptive and does not demonstrate causation.
limitations: No DSNY vehicle GPS was used.
Zone centroids and straight first/last-mile connectors are analytical approximations.
311 complaints reflect reporting behavior as well as rat activity.
Routes overlap and are not frequency-weighted vehicle counts.
